item.title: VD; Aerospace division
item.description: Atmospheric Vehicle DivisionAttack (A)Utility (U)Remote controlled (Q)Multi role (M)Helicopter (H)Cargo (C)Fighters (F)Drop ships (D)UD-47AThe most common variant. It comes with a chin gun and pylons, and can be used to move infantry and or cargoUD-47CThe fire support variant. its Bay has been extremely modified to allow the fitting of heavy weapons.UD-47CIVThe civilian the airframe. These were built with many different attachment points to allow it to be sold to many different industries.UD-47BThe vehicle transport variant is missing the Bay and is instead replaced with clamps and attachment points To load a vehicle onto the back.UD-47The prototype airframe. Only five of these were produced and they proved to do exactly what was needed, winning Vortex dynamics the contract.F/A-80The prototype airframe, It could barely fly when it was first made but after a few different variations it proved itself and production was started.F/A-80AThe single seater variant of the airframe, It only has a singular pilot. Has a slightly higher fuel capacity than the twin seater variantF/A-80BThe twin seater version of the airframe, it has pilot and a WSO, Has a slightly lower fuel capacity then the single seater variant.The F/A-80 was then made into two nearly identical airframes with the only difference being one is a twin seater and one is a solo seater variant.F/A-80TThe trainer variant, it's used to teach people the basic controls of the airframe. Used to teach people all F/A-80 Airframes.The aircraft being the twin seater variant is generally more effective than the solo variant. One reason for this is the fact that the pilot and the WSO Can both use the weapons on the aircraft at the same time. In situations where a fight quickly goes from BVR To a dog fight The aircraft can engage two targets instead of justice one. Most weapon systems can be slaved to the HMCS Which also helps with the dual weapon system use.The aircraft has a reduced load for the pilot because it can be shared with WSO, This lowers air crews suicide rates greatly by also giving them a friend in stressful situations.F／A-80BExoatmospheric Vehicle Division
